arbiter: Hand enumeration of integer labels satisfying abs(t-root) <= margin; no astronomical output

cases.derivation: No forbidden labels after a complete source scan.
The -2 root excludes label 0 inclusively; the 11 root excludes label 9 even though both roots are outside the requested domain.
Only the exact root label is excluded. Label 0 belongs to the domain and label 10 does not.
The closed integer margins 1..5 and 4..8 merge into 1..8.
Roots 4,5,6 exclude respectively 2..6,3..7,4..8. Their union is 2..8 and their intersection is 4..6.
A root anywhere in 2..8 can exclude 1..9, but no label is excluded by all allowed roots.
Any of labels 4,5,6 can be the excluded singleton and none is certainly excluded.
A second exact root excludes 2..6, including the first root's uncertain left edge. Labels 7..8 remain uncertain.
